subject.title: Feature: Support Telegram media groups (albums) in message tool

question: Should Telegram album support be implemented by extending the existing message.send/mediaUrls flow, by adding a new Telegram-specific send-media-group action, or by declining a new core message-tool surface for now?
rationale: The code gap is clear, but the durable public API shape affects message-tool discovery, channel action names, docs, and compatibility; the open external draft already chose a new action/filePaths API without maintainer confirmation.

options.title: Map albums onto mediaUrls
options.body: Use the existing message.send/mediaUrls contract and have the Telegram plugin batch only eligible media into sendMediaGroup, falling back to sequential sends otherwise.

options.title: Adopt a new action
options.body: Accept a Telegram-specific send-media-group action after documenting the new tool surface and adding compatibility/proof for current sendMessage behavior.

options.title: Decline core album surface
options.body: Leave Telegram mediaUrls as sequential sends and close or redirect album-specific behavior to a future plugin/API discussion.

recommendation.title: Map albums onto mediaUrls
recommendation.body: Use the existing message.send/mediaUrls contract and have the Telegram plugin batch only eligible media into sendMediaGroup, falling back to sequential sends otherwise.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is the strongest current-history routing candidate for the touched Telegram/outbound media paths and release provenance.
